question: Identify the antonym of "Jovial":
solution:
The correct answer is: **Morose**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Jovial"** means cheerful, friendly, and full of happiness. (प्रसन्नचित्त)
 
 
• **Example:** He had a jovial personality that made everyone around him feel at ease.
 
 
• The word **"Morose"** refers to being sullen, gloomy, or ill-tempered. (उदासीन)
 
 
• **Example:** After hearing the bad news, he became morose and didn't want to talk to anyone.
 
 
• Since "Morose" is the opposite of "Jovial," it is the correct answer.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Morose**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Cheerful** (उल्लासपूर्ण): Being noticeably happy and optimistic.
 
 
• **Example:** She always has a cheerful smile that brightens up everyone's day.
 
 
• **Happy** (खुश): Feeling or showing pleasure and contentment.
 
 
• **Example:** The children were happy to see the magician perform tricks.
 
 
• **Joyful** (आनंदित): Full of joy; experiencing or causing great happiness.
 
 
• **Example:** The reunion of the old friends was a truly joyful occasion.
 

37:Tcd3,

सही उत्तर है: **उदासीन (Morose)**।
